// diagnostic

E-MODEL-SIGNATURE

Model package `{package}` declares `{expected}` but the supplied tensor has `{actual}`

What

Model package `{package}` declares `{expected}` but the supplied tensor has `{actual}`

Why

The model boundary checks tensor names, dtypes, and shapes before a provider can run; accepting a different signature would turn a checked package into a runtime surprise.

Fix

Make the tensor name, dtype, and shape match the package declaration.
